title: RubricDefinition
description: The base rubric definition for a Canvas assignment, returned by the Assignments API with include[]=rubric. This is the criterion catalog (identifiers, descriptions, rating tiers, and point values) required to interpret and normalize per-student rubric assessment records.

rubric_id.description: Canvas rubric ID, from the assignment's rubric_settings.id.

points_possible.description: Total points possible across all criteria, from rubric_settings.points_possible.

free_form_criterion_comments.description: Whether graders may enter free-form comments instead of selecting a rating tier.

criteria.description: Ordered list of rubric criteria. Criterion 'id' values are the keys used in the corresponding rubric_assessment dictionary of a per-student rubric assessment record.

id.description: Canvas rubric criterion ID. Matches the criterion_id keys in a per-student rubric assessment.

description.description: Short criterion label shown in the rubric.

long_description.description: Extended criterion description. Empty string when not provided.

points.description: Maximum points available for this criterion.

ratings.description: Rating tiers available for this criterion, ordered as returned by Canvas.

id.description: Canvas rating ID. Matches the rating_id value in a per-student rubric assessment when this tier was selected.

description.description: Short label for this rating tier.

long_description.description: Extended description of this rating tier. Empty string when not provided.

points.description: Points awarded when this rating tier is selected.
